problems.problem: The bone 'kiln mouth' arc is still subordinate to the garment instead of framing it: shape bbox [218,430,862,1076] versus garment bbox [156,202,923,1008] means the sleeves overhang the disc by ~62px left and ~61px right, so the circle reads as a plate tucked behind the torso rather than a confident arc rising behind the silhouette; only the lower crescent (hem 1008 to disc bottom 1076, confirmed in the contact crop) carries the concept. Evidence: in the poster the cream field disappears exactly where the sleeve caps widen, breaking the arc's continuity at the garment's widest point.

The promised warm low raking light from upper left is only half delivered: mineral grain and trowel tooth are now visible across the field (improvement over the previous flat swatch), but the directional graze collapses into a mottled dark patch in the lower-right quadrant and a faint blotch upper-center, so the relief reads as speckle noise rather than a coherent rake; the matte jersey's soft front-above studio shading therefore sits on a ground whose light story does not match it. Evidence: compare the even, shadowless fold shading on the white jersey against the chaotic dark mottling right of the disc - no single light direction reconciles both.

The footer band is better balanced than last version (rule 1150, title 1196-1258, subtitle 1298-1318, ~122px bottom margin) but still reads timid against the references' disciplined footline: the 260px hairline rule at y=1150 floats ~142px below the hem with no optical tie to the type block, and the 30px subtitle is nearly invisible at campaign scale next to the 92px Bodoni title. Evidence: measured gaps - hem-to-rule 142px versus rule-to-title 46px - make the rule look stranded rather than capping the title, unlike the tight footer stacks in the Hugo Boss reference.

changes.value: Hand-troweled lime plaster wall in deep burnt rust red-orange, broad smooth trowel sweeps with soft mineral tooth, one consistent warm low raking light from upper left drawing long soft relief highlights that fade evenly toward a gently darkened lower right, uniform directional grain, no blotches, no mottling, no horizon, no props, no objects
